title: Scripture and the Gospel
definition: Scripture and the Gospel are joined because the Bible reveals God's saving message concerning sin, grace, Christ, repentance, faith, and eternal life.
summary: The Gospel is promised, revealed, explained, and proclaimed through Scripture.
christFocus: Christ died for sins and rose again according to the Scriptures.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Gospel does not originate in human religious creativity. It is the good news God promised and revealed through Scripture. The Bible explains the holiness of God, the sinfulness of humanity, the work of Christ, and the call to repentance and faith.

The Gospel is not detached from the rest of the Bible. It is the fulfillment of God's saving plan and the message by which sinners are reconciled to Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: When Scripture is separated from the Gospel, Bible teaching can become moralism, legalism, or information without salvation. This doctrine matters because Scripture is meant to lead people to the saving work of Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Keep the Gospel central when reading, teaching, and applying Scripture. Ask how the text exposes need, reveals grace, and leads to faith and obedience in Christ.
